name: Roadwolf
design_note: The reference enemy. Every other archetype is a deviation from this.

name: Barrow Knight
design_note: Very high DEF. The reason Pierce exists - Pierce beats Strike only here. Body +3 / Spirit -3: plate shrugs physical hits, but debuffs land hard.

name: Mire Hound
design_note: Fastest enemy and highest crit. Low HP. Punishes slow parties. A creature of the mire's gloom - weak to Light. Body -3 / Spirit +2: light on its feet, fragile to physical hits.

name: Stone Ox
design_note: Biggest HP pool and hardest hitter. Slowest enemy. Stone wears down under running Water - weak to it. Body +4 / Spirit -3: shrugs physical hits; debuffs land hard on a brute.

name: Fen Priest
design_note: Only enemy that heals. High RES. Kill first or the fight stalls. Heals at 30% ally HP (Ian: lowered from 60%). Body -3 / Spirit +4: spiritual, so debuffs slide off - but physical hits hurt.

name: Thorn Shrike
design_note: Reflects 6% of physical damage. High RES. The reason Gale exists. Dry bramble growth - weak to Fire. Body -2 / Spirit +3: high RES, brittle against physical hits.

name: Barrow Warden
design_note: Boss modifier applied to a rotation archetype. charge_rate 1.15. BOSS_LEN 1.40.

name: Cinder Imp
design_note: Elemental batch. Fragile fire caster - resists Fire hard and drowns under Water. Hunts Fire-weak party members first.

name: Tide Wraith
design_note: Elemental batch. Water caster whose Drench briefly Slows. Resists Water - burn it with Fire.

name: Crag Golem
design_note: Elemental batch. Slow high-DEF Earth bruiser with low RES. Air cuts through it.

name: Gale Harpy
design_note: Elemental batch. Fast evasive Air striker with quick light hits. Earth brings it down.

name: Dawn Acolyte
design_note: Elemental batch. Light caster whose Glare briefly Blinds. Dark magic unravels it.

name: Umbral Stalker
design_note: Elemental batch. Crit-prone Dark melee hunter. Light burns it away.

name: Pyre Tyrant
design_note: Elemental boss (boss rotation). HP comes from the shared boss formula - hp_multiplier unused. Bring Water.

name: Drowned Matriarch
design_note: Elemental boss (boss rotation). Bring Fire.

name: Mountain Colossus
design_note: Elemental boss (boss rotation). Huge DEF - magic and Air.

name: Storm Roc
design_note: Elemental boss (boss rotation). Fast and evasive. Bring Earth.

name: Dawn Seraph
design_note: Elemental boss (boss rotation). Bring Dark.

name: Hollow King
design_note: Elemental boss (boss rotation). Bring Light.

name: Ironhide Brute
design_note: Body batch. Slow heavy bruiser: shrugs Body (physical) hits and is wide open to debuffs. Hunts Body-weak party members first. Debuff it, or use Spirit.

name: Hollow Husk
design_note: Body batch. Spirit caster whose Wail briefly Dulls. Debuffs slide off it, but it is brittle to physical hits. Hunts Spirit-weak party members first.

name: Rotted Carrion
design_note: Body batch. Soft flesh - weak to Body (physical) hits. Its Gnaw Poisons anyone not already poisoned, so it spreads the damage over time.

name: Veilwarden
design_note: Body batch. Wards its allies (and itself) with Veilcast, then Wails. Strong in Spirit, so debuffs barely stick - kill it first or burn through the wards.

name: Iron Sovereign
charge_action_effect: AoE blow that Sunders the party
design_note: Body boss (boss rotation, southeast). HP comes from the shared boss formula - hp_multiplier unused. Shrugs physical hits; debuff it.

name: Hollow Oracle
charge_action_effect: AoE Spirit that Dulls the party
design_note: Spirit boss (boss rotation, east). HP comes from the shared boss formula - hp_multiplier unused. Debuffs slide off it; hit it with physical attacks.
